records.reason: Two-action attack activity (jump, then a Strike) resolved entirely at the table; no persistent sheet change.
Movement-plus-Trip activity; the degree-of-success upgrade is resolved at the table against a target.
Reaction that lets an adjacent ALLY reroll a save; changes only the ally's roll.
Lets you Refocus during the Cat Nap rest activity; rest/exploration timing the app does not model, and the focus points recovered are unchanged.
Adjusts the degree of success another activity (Fascinating Performance) needs against a target; resolved at the table.
One-action Launch activity with an extra damage die on that roll; resolved at the table.
Free action that extends Juggling and raises the number of items juggled; a table-tracked activity, not a sheet statistic.
Grants a conditional hidden state while concealed by mist or fog; visibility states are adjudicated at the table.
Declares that Avoid Notice/Hide/Sneak always count as taking precautions against special senses; no roll or statistic changes.
The GM rolls secret Survival checks while you Search with a dowsing rod; entirely GM-adjudicated exploration.
Grants only the Spin Tale action, performed at the table; no proficiency, statistic, or choice is conferred.
An ikon whose only benefit is the Unravel the Future transcendence activity (a fortune reroll used at the table).
One-action Strike with backswing/forceful added to that single Strike; resolved at the table.
One-action extra unarmed Strike after a miss, at the same MAP; resolved at the table.
Forces a save and applies damage, prone, and clumsy to the TARGET.
Extra information on successful Recall Knowledge checks, explicitly at the GM's discretion.
Actions gained from being quickened do not trigger reactions; a table-side reaction-trigger rule.
One-action Step-then-Strike activity; resolved at the table.

Grants fast healing 5 whenever you are in hybrid or animal shape — a real, standing self-benefit that nothing delivers. No fast-healing field exists, but the werecreature shape-gated pattern is already a mode (dire-form, dire-growth), so it belongs there with the fast healing and the silver-weapon suppression in the note.

mode.name: Force of Nature (hybrid or animal shape)
mode.duration: while you are in your hybrid or animal shape
mode.note: Fast healing 5. If you take damage from a silver weapon, the fast healing deactivates until the end of your next turn.

records.reason: Rewrites the effect of a spell you cast against a single target; the push lands on the target's side.
Ranged Strike activity whose extra effects (push, off-guard) apply to the target.
A one-minute downtime tampering activity opposed by other creatures' checks; no sheet statistic.
Reaction that redirects one incoming attack roll to your Perception DC; a per-roll table resolution, not a standing statistic.
Ignores difficult terrain caused by plants and fungi; terrain and movement cost are tracked at the table, not on the sheet.
One-action Take Cover then Hide activity; resolved at the table.

The Recall Knowledge penalty falls on other creatures, but "Add Rewrite Memory to your spell list as a primal spell" is a real player-facing grant: without it the primal-filtered spell picker will never offer Rewrite Memory. No field adds a single spell to a character's spell list/tradition (innateSpells would wrongly give it as a free innate casting), and the two other feats with the same wording (tupilaq-carver, dragon-arcana) carry no field either.
Spellshape action that changes the rank and duration of the untamed form you cast next; resolved when the spell is cast at the table.
Athletics counteract attempt against a polymorph effect on a creature you have grabbed; entirely target-side.
Alters how a battle-form polymorph spell is prepared and how long it lasts; a preparation/duration ruling handled at the table.

Upgrades the area and damage dice of the Breath of the Dragon action. That feat carries no mechanical field in core.json (it is a plain 2-action record), so the area and dice are read off the text and rolled at the table; there is nothing on the sheet to be wrong.
Offers a check to avoid gaining fascinated or stupefied when it would be applied; a per-instance roll at the table (the printed DC is even missing from the record).
Lowers the flat-check DC of the Unexpected Shift reaction and drops its dazzled rider; both are resolved when that reaction is used at the table.
Grants a reroll to the next creature OTHER THAN YOU that attacks the target; changes only an ally's roll.
A fortune reroll on a counteract check made when you cast a healing spell; a per-roll table resolution, not a statistic.
Impulse that moves up to four willing creatures; changes only the targets' positions.
Riders on a critical hit force the TARGET to save and become slowed or stunned.
Same effect as the archetype twin: a critical hit forces the TARGET to save and become slowed or stunned.
Throws a willing ally to another square; affects only the ally's position, damage, and reaction.
Shove an ally with an Athletics check; the outcome lands on the ally.
Throws an ally across the battlefield; affects only the ally's position and reaction.
Substitutes Religion for Intimidation when you Demoralize an undead and drops two traits from that action; a per-use action choice resolved at the table, not a bonus.
Adds a Demoralize attempt against each nearby opponent when you make a Startling Appearance; entirely target-side.
Applies frightened 1 or 2 to the condemned foe; target-side condition.
Line effect forcing Fortitude saves; push and prone land on the targets.

Really grants the player extra repertoire spells and extra spell slots. spellSlotBonus supports {perRank, exceptHighest, entryId} (occult-breadth uses exactly that shape for the bard archetype), but the gelid shard archetype has no spellcasting entry with slots to attach to — first-frost supplies only spellcastingGrant + at-will innateSpells, and snowcaster/expert-snowcasting/master-snowcasting carry no fields at all. Writing spellSlotBonus with no entryId would over-grant slots to the character's main caster. Needs the gelid-shard slot/repertoire entry first, plus a repertoire-size increase (no field exists for spells known).

Level-20 capstone that makes you permanently quickened — a standing extra action every turn, restricted by innovation type. No field or registry grants a persistent condition, and a mode would misrepresent a permanent, non-toggled benefit.
Changes how one Vicious Swing counts toward the multiple attack penalty; MAP is tracked at the table, not on the sheet.
Applies the grabbed condition to the foe you just hit; entirely target-side.
Multi-Stride movement activity resolved at the table; no Speed value changes.
Reaction granting one melee Strike; resolved at the table.
A daily-preparation item fusion: the fused weapon uses the higher fundamental runes of the two items, which the player represents directly by editing the item's runes in inventory.
Lets your MOUNT treat darkness as solid ground; it changes only the companion's movement options and is GM-adjudicated (no speed value, sense, or IWR is granted).
Relaxes the flanking positioning requirement; flanking is determined by table positioning, not by any sheet statistic.
Makes your snares harder for other creatures to Disable and damages them on a failure; entirely on the other creature's side.
Three-action Stride plus Create a Diversion activity; the alternate skill and the fascinated rider are resolved at the table against an enemy.
A once-per-year narrative resurrection after you die; no living-character statistic changes.
Adds forced movement of a willing ally to the Intercept Attack reaction; changes only the ally's position.
Free action to Demoralize an opponent, with temporary immunity tracked at the table; target-side.

Makes your Strikes magical and ghost touch against incorporeal creatures; this only changes how your damage interacts with a target's resistances, which the app resolves on the target's side, not on your sheet.
Same as the Ghost Eater benefit: magical/ghost touch Strikes against incorporeal creatures, which only affects how the target's resistances apply.
